# Resume bullets (generated by `qr ledger`)

Values are copied from RESULTS.md. `[id]` = no ledger value yet: do not use that bullet until it is filled. Lead with OOS numbers; label development numbers walk-forward. Avoid the word "alpha" if the OOS CI includes 0 or the DSR is below 0.95; use the null variant.

1. Built a survivorship-bias-free NSE daily equity panel from raw exchange archives: 3658 sessions and 3818 securities, including 214 later-delisted names that were in the liquid universe, 2012-2026. It merges two exchange file formats, uses ISIN-linked split, bonus and dividend adjustment and a point-in-time liquidity universe, and a truncation-based test checks it for look-ahead.
2. Tested 8 point-in-time cross-sectional signals with Newey-West inference. The strongest sector-, beta- and size-neutral signal, REV_5, reached a mean rank IC of 0.030 (t = 11.826, 5-day horizon, 2013-2024). 12 of 16 tests cleared a t >= 3 hurdle after Holm correction.
3. Compared equal-weight z-score, ridge and LightGBM combiners under purged, embargoed walk-forward CV (8 folds). LGBM achieved a rank IC of 0.059, against 0.045 for equal weight (paired IC-difference t = 6.887).
4. Modelled Indian execution costs: time-varying STT including the 2026 futures hike, exchange fees, stamp duty, GST, Abdi-Ranaldo spreads and square-root impact. A long-only top-decile book against the Nifty 500 index earned a walk-forward net IR of -0.917 (gross 1.728), at 29.095x one-way turnover a year; capacity: none (net metric <= 0 at Rs 1 crore).
5. Enforced research hygiene with a pre-registered protocol, a lock-file-guarded 24-month holdout read once, and 76 logged trials (N_eff = 21). Holdout results: long-only net IR -1.406 (95% CI -2.989, -0.034). F&O long-short net Sharpe -4.448. Deflated Sharpe 0.000 (development window).

**Null-result variant of bullet 5.** Holdout net IR was -1.406 (95% CI -2.989, -0.034). A gross edge of 0.852 did not survive 2179.790 bp a year of costs, 26.048% of them STT. Deflated Sharpe 0.000.
